metadata.title: Why Analysts Are Bullish on Palantir Stock?

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) kept a bullish Wall Street call Monday after Baird left its Outperform rating and $200 target unchanged.
The view followed a technology demonstration attended by Baird analyst William Power, who pointed to Palantir's software platform as a potential advantage as companies adopt agent-based AI tools. He also cited opportunities tied to open-weight models and government-led AI projects.
The analyst's stance comes after Palantir reported second-quarter revenue of $1.94 billion, an increase of 93% from a year earlier. Adjusted earnings were 41 cents per share, while U.S. commercial sales climbed 149% to $764 million. The company raised its 2026 revenue forecast to $8.15 billion to $8.16 billion.
Other analysts have also lifted targets in recent weeks. UBS raised its view to $220, Mizuho to $215 and Citigroup to $245, while Deutsche Bank moved to a Buy rating with a $200 target.
Baird's stance keeps attention on Palantir's ability to convert rising AI adoption into sustained commercial and government growth.
